driver_archetypes.rationale: Saval et al. 2023: conservative car parameters; high tau and low accel/decel reflect cautious behavior to match observed discharge headways.
Car violators (custom2) drawn from the 'car' distribution; currently compliant (p=0) to match M3/share/car low red-running and M2/early/car near-zero early start.

Saval et al. 2023 motorcycle baseline: higher accel/decel ratio, short tau (aggressive following), wide minGap (1.9m) to match observed overshoot depth; narrow lateral gap (0.3m) matches lane-center riding.

Motorcycle violators (custom1) drawn from the 'moto' distribution; increased share to 0.4 combined with moto_saval=0.6 to sum exactly 1.0 for the 'moto' distribution, boosting wrong-lane usage probability and queue space seeking frequency.
Illegal left-turning motorcycles (distribution moto_violator); share 1.0 ensures the 'moto_violator' distribution sums to exactly 1.0, retaining jmTimegapMinor for box-waiting mechanics.

traci_rules.rationale: Saval et al. 2023: motorcycles at the stop line have a 50% chance to run red (p0=0.5); k=0 removes swarm effect as no follower influence observed; p_max caps probability.
Targets M2/early/moto (observed share 0.1303): increased p from 0.13 to 0.15 and t_before_green from 5s to 4s to boost early-start frequency; v_max limits creep speed.
Targets M8/moto (wrong-lane share 0.2131): increased p_wrong_lane from 0.21 to 0.25 to better match observed lateral encroachment; q=35m triggers seeking at moderate queues.
Field observation: most motos pass a standing U-turner; p=0.8 (80% probability) and t_wait=2s reflects quick lateral filtering.
Field observation: cars rarely bypass U-turners; p=0.1 (10% probability) matches conservative car behaviour.
